scope: Exact archive, comparison, replay and verification commands. Read-only discovery and writing this command manifest are excluded.

commands.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('docs/audit/artifacts/reference_fixture');sha=lambda data:hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
manifest=json.loads((base/'release-completed-raw-archives.json').read_text())
for row in manifest['archives']:
 data=Path(row['original_path']).read_bytes();stored=Path(row['archive_path']).read_bytes()
 assert gzip.decompress(stored)==data
 assert sha(data)==row['original_sha256']==row['decompressed_sha256']
 assert sha(stored)==row['archive_sha256']
for path,digest in manifest['prior_archives_verified_unchanged'].items():assert sha(Path(path).read_bytes())==digest
comparison=json.loads((base/'release-capture-comparison.json').read_text())
assert {c['label'] for c in comparison['captures']}=={'release-cap8-01','release-mixed8-01','release-cap1-ble-parallel-01'}
for row in comparison['captures']:
 assert row['files']['raw']['summary_hash_matches']
 assert all(row['existing_analysis_recheck'].values())
 print('CAPTURE',row['label'],'status',row['collector']['status'],'seconds',row['collector']['capture_seconds'],'frames',row['capture_window']['all_raw_complete_frames'],'CRC',row['parser_counters']['crc_errors'],'identity',row['capture_errors']['identity_errors'],'fixture_assessment',row['fixture_analysis_status'])
index=json.loads((base/'release-special-evidence-index.json').read_text());ble=index['ble_record']
assert [x['completed_requests'] for x in index['control_sequence_records']]==[28,50]
assert ble['replay_verification']['DATA_bytes_match']
assert ble['replay_verification']['logical_messages_and_receive_timestamps_match']
assert ble['offline_protocol']['parser_counters']['cap_frames']==9131
assert ble['offline_protocol']['identity_errors']==0
assert all(group['sequence_gaps']==0 for group in ble['offline_protocol']['groups'])
print(json.dumps({'status':'EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_VERIFIED','archive_count':len(manifest['archives']),'prior_archives_unchanged':len(manifest['prior_archives_verified_unchanged']),'BLE_replayed_logical_messages':ble['replay_verification']['logical_message_count'],'BLE_frames':9131,'active_RES8_untouched':True}))
